newsitem.title: UK: Granada sells Welcome Break to Investcorp.
newsitem.headline: Granada sells Welcome Break to Investcorp.

text.p: British hotels and leisure group Granada Group Plc said on Tuesday that it had exchanged contracts to sell Welcome Break Ltd to the Bahrain-based Investcorp for 476 million stg.
The group also announced the sale of its two Westbury Hotels in London and New York for 90 million stg to Chelsfield Plc.
Granada said the sale of Welcome Break represented a multiple of 22 times historic earnings and a premium to net book value of 142.6 million pounds.
Both deals are expected to be completed by March. The deals take take the aggregate value of disposals by Granada since the acquisition of Forte to over 1.2 billion pounds.
Granada's chief executive Charles Allen said, "Welcome Break and Westbury hotels have been sold for excellent prices, firmly underscoring the benefit of our patient approach".

Richard Warner, part of Investcorp's management committee said the group would make sufficient improvement in the Welcome Break Motorway Service Areas and will directly benefit the UK motorist. Welcome Break has more than 30 percent market share in UK's motorway service areas.
